description: Agent partials HUD window. Scopes IPC + the o8:stt-event subscription to the 'agent-partials' label so the always-on /agent-partials webview can listen and render the outside-the-window live transcription bar during an agent-lane (Right-Option) dictation. Without a capability whose `remote.urls` matches the bundled-Next origin AND whose `windows` includes 'agent-partials', Tauri injects no __TAURI_INTERNALS__ into this remote-URL webview, so isTauri() is false and listen() never attaches — the window would stay blank. Label-disciplined: events only, NO window-control / updater / process / shell perms (those stay main-only per agent_partials_window.rs).
